rule: One scannable pattern per limit the syllabus states (curriculum/syllabus-facts.json stated_exclusions). Each pattern is written against the objective it qualifies so that it catches the excluded detail and leaves the required content alone; build_curriculum_evidence.py tests every must_catch and must_leave_alone example and stops on a failure. Two 2026-10-17 patterns were too broad and are narrowed here: 'water potential' is required in 3.3.2 (osmosis) and excluded only for tissue fluid in 3.8.2; 'maternal and paternal chromosomes' is the wording of objective 4.1 itself, so only the excluded mechanism detail is caught.

must_catch: the base adenine pairs with thymine
must_leave_alone: A always pairs with T, and C with G
two strands form a double helix

patterns.construct: roles of water potential and hydrostatic pressure in tissue-fluid exchange
must_catch: hydrostatic pressure forces fluid out of the capillary
must_leave_alone: water moves by osmosis from a higher water potential to a lower water potential

patterns.pattern: \b(nephrons?|glomerul\w*|Bowman'?s capsule|loop of Henl[eé]|proximal tubule|distal tubule|collecting duct|ultrafiltration)\b
must_catch: blood is filtered in the glomerulus
must_leave_alone: the kidney removes urea and excess water
glucose and some salts are reabsorbed

patterns.construct: detail of the pancreatic cells that secrete insulin
must_catch: insulin is made by beta cells
must_leave_alone: Type 1 diabetes is treated with insulin injections

patterns.limit_contains: details of stages are not required
must_catch: during metaphase the chromosomes line up
must_leave_alone: mitosis gives genetically identical daughter nuclei

patterns.construct: mechanism detail of how meiosis produces variation
must_catch: crossing over swaps genes between chromosomes
must_leave_alone: meiosis forms new combinations of maternal and paternal chromosomes

patterns.construct: endosperm production and seed development detail
must_leave_alone: the pollen tube enters the ovule and the male nucleus fuses with the female nucleus
